_note: Owner fills these. null values are rendered as placeholders/noindex, never invented.
_note_audience: Play Families/target-audience answer, one or two sentences, e.g. who the app is for and that it does not knowingly collect data from children. Required before the policy stops showing "Draft".
_note_ads: null = ads-off build (default). Set to "live" only for a build made with STREET_JAM_ADS=live and owner ad ids.
